description: Tests a live page with Google PageSpeed Insights: SEO, performance, accessibility and best practices scores, Core Web Vitals and the failed checks. Uses one of the workspace's monthly SEO tests, so run it once before fixing and once after the user publishes, never in a loop. url defaults to the project's live host URL, else the last tested URL. Waits up to about a minute; if Google is still working it returns the runId for get_seo_report.

url.description: Public address of the live page, e.g. https://example.com/pricing (not the Xodia preview)

name: run_seo_test
title: Run SEO test
